title: Show Hidden Icons button could be part of the flow, so it doesn't wastefully take up an entire row in a wide vertical panel
line: In wide vertical or thick horizontal panels, the system tray's Show Hidden Icons arrow now sits next to the last icon instead of taking a whole row or column.
explanation: The system tray lays its icons out in a GridView and puts the expander arrow next to it in a GridLayout, always in a separate row (vertical panels) or column (horizontal panels). When the icons wrap into several rows or columns, the arrow therefore wasted a whole row or column even when the last one had free cells. The arrow now counts as one more grid cell when there are several rows or columns: the grid reserves that cell and the arrow is placed on it with layout margins, so it follows the icon order (including reversed order and RTL). Single-row/column trays and 'Scale icons to fit' keep the old layout.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: let the expander arrow flow with the icons

When the tray icons wrap into several rows or columns, the Show Hidden
Icons arrow always took a whole row or column of its own. It now takes
the cell after the last icon, so it sits next to it when there is room.

BUG: 461983

patches.diff:
From aee4330e8362c6ce08143e767906cd45ca344e4e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:54:06 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/systemtray: let the expander arrow flow with the
 icons

When the tray icons wrap into several rows or columns, the Show Hidden
Icons arrow always took a whole row or column of its own. It now takes
the cell after the last icon, so it sits next to it when there is room.

BUG: 461983
---
 applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml | 33 +++++++++++++++++++++++++--------
 1 file changed, 25 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml b/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml
index b5cb44ce79..c72adbb14a 100644
--- a/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml
@@ -217,7 +217,11 @@ ContainmentItem {
 
                 readonly property int gridThickness: root.vertical ? root.width : root.height
                 // Should change to 2 rows/columns on a 56px panel (in standard DPI)
-                readonly property int rowsOrColumns: autoSize ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.min(count, Math.floor(gridThickness / (smallIconSize + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing))))
+                readonly property int maxRowsOrColumns: Math.max(1, Math.floor(gridThickness / (smallIconSize + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)))
+                // With several rows/columns, the expander takes the cell after the last icon instead of a row/column of its own
+                readonly property bool expanderInGrid: !autoSize && maxRowsOrColumns > 1 && count > 0 && root.hiddenLayout.itemCount > 0
+                readonly property int cellCount: count + (expanderInGrid ? 1 : 0)
+                readonly property int rowsOrColumns: autoSize ? 1 : Math.min(maxRowsOrColumns, Math.max(1, cellCount))
 
                 // Add margins only if the panel is larger than a small icon (to avoid large gaps between tiny icons)
                 readonly property int cellSpacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * Plasmoid.configuration.iconSpacing
@@ -239,8 +243,8 @@ ContainmentItem {
                 }
 
                 //depending on the form factor, we are calculating only one dimension, second is always the same as root/parent
-                implicitHeight: root.vertical ? cellHeight * Math.ceil(count / rowsOrColumns) : root.height
-                implicitWidth: !root.vertical ? cellWidth * Math.ceil(count / rowsOrColumns) : root.width
+                implicitHeight: root.vertical ? cellHeight * Math.ceil(cellCount / rowsOrColumns) : root.height
+                implicitWidth: !root.vertical ? cellWidth * Math.ceil(cellCount / rowsOrColumns) : root.width
 
                 readonly property int itemSize: {
                     if (autoSize) {
@@ -278,12 +282,25 @@ ContainmentItem {
             ExpanderArrow {
                 id: expander
 
-                Layout.row: root.vertical && !root.reverseLayout ? 1 : 0 // Explicitly define grid coordinates
-                Layout.column: root.vertical ? 0 : 1                     // to prevent overlapping
+                // Position of the cell after the last icon, used when the expander is part of the grid
+                readonly property int cellX: tasksGrid.cellWidth * (root.vertical ? tasksGrid.count % tasksGrid.rowsOrColumns : Math.floor(tasksGrid.count / tasksGrid.rowsOrColumns))
+                readonly property int cellY: {
+                    const y = tasksGrid.cellHeight * (root.vertical ? Math.floor(tasksGrid.count / tasksGrid.rowsOrColumns) : tasksGrid.count % tasksGrid.rowsOrColumns);
+                    return root.vertical && root.reverseLayout ? tasksGrid.implicitHeight - tasksGrid.cellHeight - y : y;
+                }
+
+                Layout.row: tasksGrid.expanderInGrid ? tasksGrid.Layout.row : (root.vertical && !root.reverseLayout ? 1 : 0) // Explicitly define grid coordinates
+                Layout.column: root.vertical || tasksGrid.expanderInGrid ? 0 : 1                                               // to prevent overlapping
+
+                // When part of the grid, the margins place the expander on its cell over the grid
+                Layout.leftMargin: tasksGrid.expanderInGrid ? cellX + Math.round((tasksGrid.cellWidth - iconSize) / 2) : 0
+                Layout.rightMargin: tasksGrid.expanderInGrid ? tasksGrid.implicitWidth - Layout.leftMargin - iconSize : 0
+                Layout.topMargin: tasksGrid.expanderInGrid ? cellY + Math.round((tasksGrid.cellHeight - iconSize) / 2) : 0
+                Layout.bottomMargin: tasksGrid.expanderInGrid ? tasksGrid.implicitHeight - Layout.topMargin - iconSize : 0
 
-                Layout.fillWidth: vertical
-                Layout.fillHeight: !vertical
-                Layout.alignment: vertical ? Qt.AlignVCenter : Qt.AlignHCenter
+                Layout.fillWidth: vertical && !tasksGrid.expanderInGrid
+                Layout.fillHeight: !vertical && !tasksGrid.expanderInGrid
+                Layout.alignment: tasksGrid.expanderInGrid ? Qt.AlignCenter : (vertical ? Qt.AlignVCenter : Qt.AlignHCenter)
                 iconSize: tasksGrid.itemSize
                 visible: root.hiddenLayout.itemCount > 0
             }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Wide vertical panel: the arrow takes a row of its own under the battery
Same panel: the arrow sits next to the battery
Thick horizontal panel (two rows): the arrow takes a column of its own
Same panel: the arrow takes the free cell under the battery
